name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is a junior silver-gold explorer focused on its 100%-owned Diablillos project in Salta Province, Argentina. The Diablillos deposit hosts a significant silver-gold resource and the company is advancing it toward a development decision. AbraSilver graduated from the TSX Venture Exchange to the Toronto Stock Exchange in February 2025, trading under the symbol ABRA.
